handoffs.message: Implemented statsmodels cointegration adapter skeleton. Artifacts: adapter.py (cointegration_test → {p_value, spread, half_life}), smoke_test.py (deterministic synthetic series, p_value < 0.05 assertion, signal_snapshot with SHA-256 checksum), __init__.py, contract.md, Dockerfile. Syntax check passes. Full smoke test requires Docker (statsmodels==0.14.2). Commit: 8814c15d.

Review failed: smoke test does not run. PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest -q services/research/statsmodels/smoke_test.py fails during collection because services/research/statsmodels/__init__.py imports .adapter, but existing services/research/statsmodels/adapter/ package shadows the new adapter.py; direct python services/research/statsmodels/smoke_test.py fails with the same missing cointegration_test import. Please move cointegration_test into the existing adapter package or otherwise remove the adapter.py/package name collision, then rerun py_compile and smoke test.

Shadowing fix implemented and committed (a7ba196e). adapter.py deleted; cointegration_test moved to adapter/cointegration.py and re-exported via adapter/__init__.py. Syntax check: py_compile OK for all Python files. diff --check clean. Full smoke requires statsmodels in Docker (statsmodels==0.14.2). Acceptance: cointegration_test(prices_a, prices_b) returns {p_value, spread, half_life}; smoke_test.py asserts p_value < 0.05 on deterministic seed-42 series; signal_snapshot artifact with SHA-256 checksum; requirements.txt pins statsmodels==0.14.2; no other services/research/ subdir modified.

Review requested changes: Docker image builds, and docker run --rm pantheon-statsmodels-smoke:oss-stat-001 python smoke_test.py passes with signal_snapshot checksum 016252267637129889b5611ddaa371b47c5d7b14d32c26417b89b379b4ae9fb4; however default docker run --rm pantheon-statsmodels-smoke:oss-stat-001 fails with /usr/local/bin/python: No module named pytest because Dockerfile CMD uses python -m pytest -q smoke_test.py while requirements.txt does not install pytest. Please either install pytest in the task-scoped image requirements or change Dockerfile CMD to python smoke_test.py, then re-run docker build and default docker run. py_compile and from adapter import cointegration_test passed; adapter exports adapter.cointegration.
Helper-claimed by idle Codex; previous owner Claude becomes reviewer.

Statsmodels Dockerfile default CMD now runs python smoke_test.py without pytest. Verified: python3 -m py_compile smoke_test.py adapter/cointegration.py adapter/__init__.py; docker build -t pantheon-statsmodels-smoke:oss-stat-001 services/research/statsmodels; docker run --rm pantheon-statsmodels-smoke:oss-stat-001 passed with signal_snapshot checksum 016252267637129889b5611ddaa371b47c5d7b14d32c26417b89b379b4ae9fb4.
Review approved: all 5 acceptance criteria pass. py_compile OK, import OK, diff-check clean, Dockerfile CMD fixed. Returned to Codex for closeout.
